notes.description: Brief notes about occlusion, arm placement, pose impact, or how the subject view affects garment presentation. Use an empty string if no important note.

category.description: Examples: shirt, blouse, jacket, coat, knit_top, pants, skirt, dress, shorts, other.

main_refs.description: Reference image indexes that define the main garment silhouette and overall construction. These indexes start from 2 because image 1 is always the subject image.

detail_refs.description: Reference image indexes for useful detail images. Return an empty array if there are no useful detail references.

shape.description: The garment silhouette and key structural shape. Focus on overall shape, volume, shoulder line, waist line, hem, leg shape, skirt line, or major construction cues.

fabric_behavior.description: How the fabric should behave when worn, such as crisp, structured, soft, fluid, controlled drape, smooth, or tidy.

presentation.description: How the garment should be presented on the subject to best show its shape, such as visually flat front panel, strong three-dimensional silhouette, smooth flowing skirt, clean waistband, or minimal unnecessary wrinkles.

must_preserve.description: Critical garment regions or structural elements that must stay faithful, such as collar shape, shoulder line, waistband, placket, pocket shape, or hem line.

key_details.description: Only include clearly useful and clearly identifiable garment details. Do not include tiny ambiguous details that cannot be reliably placed.

region.description: The garment region where the detail belongs, such as left_chest, collar, cuff, waistband, front_placket, hem, pocket, zipper_area. Use a short clear label.

description.description: A short factual description of the detail, such as small embroidered logo, exposed metal zipper, contrast button row, floral print panel, or ribbed cuff.

source_refs.description: Reference image indexes that show this detail.
